question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**influential**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The passage describes Aristotle as one of the greatest philosophers whose ideas shaped centuries of thought.
 
• The adjective in blank (1) should describe Aristotle’s great importance and lasting impact on philosophy.
 
• "**Influential**" fits best because it means having great influence or impact, which matches the context of Aristotle’s philosophical legacy.
 
• Other options like "**average**", "**unknown**", or "**modern**" do not fit the context, as Aristotle was neither ordinary, unknown, nor modern.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Average**: Suggests mediocrity, which contradicts Aristotle’s greatness.
 
• **Unknown**: Incorrect, as Aristotle is one of the most well-known philosophers.
 
• **Modern**: Inappropriate, as Aristotle belonged to ancient Greece.
